prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1046; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding a collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you confirm the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any electronic communications. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any subsequent proceeding.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. We look forward to your written response.
